method_notes: Head height: top of the vision glass above the finished floor of the point's storey.
Eye height: views.eye_height_m, with the source given in views.eye_height_source.
Objects at 7.5 m: solid-angle-weighted median outside distance over a 360 x 60 degree panorama (ClimateStudio method, not LEED text).
Objects closer than views.method.min_outside_distance_m beyond the glass are looked through (ClimateStudio default, not LEED text).
Interior glass: a view may cross at most views.max_interior_glass partitions.
Roof glass (skylights, roof monitors, sloped roof glass) and diffusing glass are not vision glazing: they block view rays and set no head height.

score.reason: result is 100.0 %, which reaches the 75.0 % band

warnings: the 30 % cap on views into interior atria is not assessed; a view through interior glass counts like any other
no ground surface: ground taken at the lowest floor level, z = 0.00
